ios.desc:
Convert over 900 currencies, check live exchange rates, track crypto assets, and use reliable offline tools anywhere you travel. This fast and accurate currency converter helps you calculate money even without an internet connection.

Whether you need USD to EUR, JPY to USD, or crypto conversions like BTC, ETH, and USDT, you get instant and accurate results.

Currency Conversion:
        •        Live rates for 900+ currencies
        •        Fast and accurate conversions
        •        Historical charts and real-time updates
        •        Full offline support using cached rates

Offline Mode:
Use the converter during flights, trips, or when mobile data is expensive. Your last updated rates remain available offline.

Crypto Converter:
        •        Supports BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOT and more
        •        Convert crypto to fiat instantly
        •        Live and historical price data

Designed for Speed:
        •        No ads
        •        No account required
        •        Lightweight and reliable

Download the app today to get fast, accurate currency and crypto conversions online or offline.

Privacy Policy: https://www.ark-builders.dev/apps/rate/privacy-policy
Support: support@ark-builders.dev
